Reply_CacheProblem.description: A local cache or recording failure, independent of what the provider returned.

Reply_CivicEvidenceSignificance.description: Native CIViC evidence significance, from the live EvidenceSignificance enum.

Reply_DrugGet.description: A source-selected drug request echoed with a native ID after name resolution, otherwise with the name as given.

civic_cursor.description:
CIViC continuation.
Native continuation cursor for that exact drug, profile and claim collection. Only with --source civic.

civic_kind.description:
CIViC collection.
Independent native evidence or assertion collection within the selected profile. Only with --source civic.

civic_profile.description:
CIViC profile.
Selected native CIViC molecular profile for a drug-scoped claim stream. Only with --source civic.

decision_from.description:
From date.
Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD status date; Drugs@FDA approvals. Only with section approvals.

decision_to.description:
To date.
Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD status date; Drugs@FDA approvals. Only with section approvals.

document_id.description:
FDA letter document ID.
Exact native Drugs@FDA approval letter document ID. Text is bounded to 25 MiB, 100 pages
and 6144 escaped bytes per fragment. No-text scans are explicit. Only with --source drugsfda. Only with section approvals.

every_version.description:
Read every version.
Label history reads every version in order, up to its read bound, instead of halving. Only with section label-history.

evidence_level.description:
A–E
Native CIViC evidence levels; repeat to include several levels.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

evidence_significance.description:
Significance
Native CIViC evidence significance, such as resistance or sensitivityresponse.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

evidence_status.description:
Status
Native CIViC evidence status; omitted preserves the source's existing default.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

find.description:
Label text; OR.
Literal text; repeat for OR. Ignore case and whitespace breaks; history also ignores hyphenation. Current labels: two excerpts per section, up to five sections and five comma-separated SPL set IDs. Only with section label or label-history.

input.description: Native source ID after name resolution, otherwise the requested name as given, spaces included.

label_section.description:
Exact openFDA SPL fields.
Exact published openFDA SPL section fields, including table fields, separated by commas; each is its own part of one reply. Omit it to list names.
The printed label's warnings_and_precautions reads openFDA's warnings_and_cautions.
A section the label lacks, or a name openFDA does not use, lists the sections the label has.
For drugsfda label-history, one of boxed_warning, indications_and_usage, contraindications,
warnings_and_cautions, adverse_reactions, drug_interactions or use_in_specific_populations.
Only with section label or label-history.

partner.description:
Interaction partner.
A DDInter ID or complete drug name, ignoring letter case; DDInter interactions only.
Keeps only the pairs with that drug. A name DDInter does not use is tried under the
names other sources state for it, as the drug itself is.

product_number.description:
FDA product number.
Explicit native application product number, only for approvals. Only with --source drugsfda. Only with section approvals.

section.description: Named disclosures of the selected source, each its own part of one reply; empty means identity only.
section.title: Source sections.

section_limit.description:
Named section page size, refused on an identity-only card.
At most 200 rows for approvals, interactions, label, regulatory, xrefs and essential-medicines; 50 elsewhere.

section_offset.description: Named section continuation, refused on an identity-only card; label-history --every-version starts at this version.

Reply_DrugHeader.description: One source candidate, without authorization, targets, label text or interactions.

application_numbers.description: The label's FDA application numbers, such as NDA216340, as openFDA states them; openFDA labels only.

effective_date.description: The label's effective date, as openFDA's `effective_time` states it; openFDA labels only.

identity_level.description: Level established only by the endpoint or record type.

matched_name.description: Complete native name fields matching the search input; omitted outside label searches.

matched_sentence.description: The label sentence holding the searched mechanism wording; openFDA label mechanism searches only.

name_resolution.description: Exact name choice, ranking rule and bounded alternative commands; omitted for native ID calls.

source.description: The single source responsible for this header.

version.description: Native source revision, omitted when the source supplies none.

Reply_DrugId.description: A published native drug record identifier, without a consumer source prefix.

Reply_DrugIdentityLevel.description: Identity level established by the source endpoint or record type, never inferred from ID shape.

Reply_DrugLabelHistory.description: The version of one section of an application's label in which searched text first appears.

answer.description: What the versions read establish about when the text appeared.

before.description: The latest version before `first` whose section was read and holds no searched text.

first.description: The earliest confirmed match read, if the reply can establish one.

method.description: How versions were chosen, and the assumption the answer rests on when it rests on one.

not_opened.description:
Versions this call never opened. An unopened version leaves the answer open if it
precedes the earliest match or if no match was found.

on_or_before.description:
True when any version older than `first` was unreadable or unopened.
The first appearance could be earlier than `first`.

read.description: Every version opened, oldest first, with what reading it found.

stopped.description:
True when the call stopped at its read bound or time limit before the search finished;
the reply's next step continues with `--every-version` and `--section-offset`.

versions.description: Label versions Drugs@FDA lists for the application: one per distinct label PDF.

Reply_DrugNameMatch.description: Complete native name fields matching the requested label name.

Reply_DrugNameResolution.description: Exact source name choice; brand before generic, FDA application then earliest approval, labels by holder then indications, else source order.

alternatives.description: Up to five other exact records as ready get commands.

basis.description: Name basis selected after demoting a brand identical to its own ingredient.

ranking.description: Applied ambiguity ordering, emitted only from fixed nonempty rule text.

reason.description: Which record was chosen and why, with counts of the others by kind; label names only.

total.description: Distinct exact-name source records found among the rows read, including the selected record; MyChem reads at most 250 rows.

Reply_DrugSection.description: Explicit drug disclosures; identity cards never expand into these sections.
x-enum-descriptions: All native identity cross-references and product links, mechanically paged; MyChem rows include ChEMBL ATC codes.
Native CIViC therapy evidence and profile context.
One exact native label heading; label replies also name the application numbers and recent major changes.
Native application and product history rows.
The Drugs@FDA label version whose --label-section first holds a --find text, read from FDA's label PDFs.

Native DDInter partner rows and levels; five rows per default page, with explicit section limits preserved. `levels` counts pairs per level across every page. DDInter's published files carry a level per pair and no management or mechanism text; `next` offers a search for the drug's openFDA label, whose drug_interactions section has that text.
One row per market (Drugs@FDA, EMA, WHO prequalification), each from its own source; --source names one market.
Essential Medicines List listings from the eEML: core or complementary, section, indication, date added, therapeutic alternatives and Expert Committee text; five per default page.

Reply_Incomplete.description: One thing a `partial` reply is missing, pointing at the detail already in the reply.

at.description: JSON pointer into this reply, such as `/sources/1` or a record's field.

code.description: The refused record's own problem code, when a problem is the cause.

reason.description: Why, when a typed source reason is known.

source.description: The source whose data is missing.

Reply_LabelHistorySection.description: A prescribing-information section, named as openFDA names its label fields.
x-enum-descriptions: Section 5, Warnings and Precautions; WARNINGS and PRECAUTIONS in older labels.
Section 6, Adverse Reactions, including any postmarketing subsection.

Reply_LabelVersion.description: One label version: the supplement whose approval it came with.

approved.description: The supplement's Drugs@FDA submission status date.

label.description: The label PDF: given on `first`, on `before` and on unread versions in `read`.

submission.description: Submission type and number, such as `SUPPL 4`.

Reply_LabelVersionMatch.description: The first matching version and the sentences that hold the searched text.

approved.description: The supplement's Drugs@FDA submission status date.

heading.description:
The subsection heading above the first match, as the label's contents name it, such as
`6.2 Postmarketing Experience`.

label.description: The label PDF: given on `first`, on `before` and on unread versions in `read`.

letter.description: The supplement's FDA letter, when Drugs@FDA lists one.

private_use.description:
True when the section's text holds private-use characters, which stand for symbols,
digits or letters the PDF's fonts do not name; a searched text with them may be missed.

sentences.description:
At most two distinct sentences holding a searched text, each at most 300 characters,
as the PDF's text gives them.

submission.description: Submission type and number, such as `SUPPL 4`.

Reply_LabelVersionState.description: What reading one label version found.

Reply_PageInfo.description: Search counts after filtering and deduplication.

total.description: Total matches: the source's own count when one source states more than the snapshot holds, otherwise the identities held by this snapshot.

truncated.description: Matching source count exceeded the retrieved window.

Reply_PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Reply_PoolInfo.description: Fixed lifetime and size of a stored search snapshot.

created.description: Publication wall time in Unix seconds.

expires.description: Fixed expiry wall time in Unix seconds.

Reply_Problem.description: A field that could not be accepted from a source record.

code.description: Why the field value was not accepted.

record.description:
The record's canonical identifier, when known. A `record.declined` problem has none, so
it names the record by a source key, such as `event_id:100178`.

source.description: The source that supplied the record.

Reply_ProblemCode.description: A stable code for a rejected field value.
x-enum-descriptions: The field value was not recognized.
Native collection exceeds the admitted complete source page.
A source repeats one exact identity with incompatible records.
A source record without a usable identity was left off the page; each problem names one such record.
The asked filter cannot read the records the field names, so they were not searched and may hold matches the page leaves out.

Reply_Reason.description: Why a source could not supply data.
x-enum-descriptions: The requested record was not found.
The public bucket does not hold an open text record.
Publisher response is not a PDF.
The local reader does not support the file or container format.
The response exceeds an explicit reader resource bound.
The source limited the request rate.
The local source quota refused admission without a network request.
Platform or configured certificate verification failed.
Connecting to or negotiating the configured proxy failed.
The reply could not be used.
The source data was being synchronized.
Identity lacks the identifier required to join this source.
The source document was read but does not state the value.

Reply_Source.description: A source of BioMCP data, identified by its canonical short name.
x-enum-descriptions: ChEMBL native records and carried component.
WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, from the WHO eEML.
MyChem DrugBank Open identity subset only.
openFDA FAERS drug adverse event reports.
Source-reported MedDRA reaction labels and versions.
NCBI Genetic Testing Registry public reports.
openFDA medical device product recall records.
FDA Drug Safety Communications web pages.
Public cBioPortal with study-specific reuse terms.
Orphadata Science epidemiology and natural-history files.

Reply_SourceNotice.description: A source notice or request recovery step.

message.description: Why the names were expanded or retained.

names.description: Names actually searched; ambiguous identities retain the typed name only.

oneOf.description: Variant spellings and registry fields actually searched.

codon.description: Codon forms searched, which match trials written for any change at that position.

input.description: Whole caller-supplied variant or criteria text.

message.description: What was searched, where, and how to search the typed text only.

spellings.description: Spellings of the same change actually searched, including the typed text.

oneOf.description: Local request limits, source observations and recovery guidance.

data_date.description: Retained publisher dataset date, independent of acquisition and record events.

message.description: Reviewed guidance; any quoted provider wording remains source data.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds left before another source request may be admitted.

oneOf.description: Registered conditions lack the literal words requested in a condition search.

message.description: The source searches several fields and can expand terms; no expansion cause is inferred.

oneOf.description: A checked provider answer survived a local cache failure.

reason.description: Bounded local failure without paths or database diagnostics.

oneOf.description: The source still has graph pages after the bounded fetch window.

fallback.description: Default-source command offering another graph view.

oneOf.description: An empty LitVar lookup can be repeated with a caller-supplied rsID.

message.description: Guidance that never supplies or infers an rsID.

oneOf.description: PubMed supplied a named ESearch warning without changing its phrases.

name.description: Original provider warning name, including names added by PubMed later.

phrases.description: Original provider phrases, preserving whitespace and quotes.

oneOf.description: PubMed did not index these words.

Reply_SourceOutcome.description: One source's outcome with source notices and request guidance.

notices.description: Source notices and request recovery guidance.

use.description: Reviewed source use category; publisher terms remain authoritative: see `help sources`.

Reply_SourceState.description: State of a source actually asked by the command.

Reply_Step.description: A command argument list spelled from a typed action.

options.description:
Options this call also takes, each with a placeholder to fill in, such as
`"--decision-from": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"`; add any of them to `args`. MCP names them as tool
arguments. Absent when the step is only runnable as it is.

Reply_StepKind.description: Purpose of an available next command.

Reply_Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

Reply_Use.description: Reviewed source-use category, without inferring rights in individual records.

description:
One versioned command response; schema identity comes only from its body type.
JSON readers ignore unknown fields and unknown growable enum values within a major.

absent.description: IDs a get of several did not find while it found others; each item says so too.

fields.description:
The row fields the caller chose with `--fields`, as given; absent without them.
Each row keeps those, its required keys and identifiers; other keys are left out.

incomplete.description: What a `partial` reply is missing; present only on `partial` replies.

local_error.description: Bounded local cache or recording failure, independent of provider outcomes.

page.description: Search page metadata. With zero results, `total` and `returned` are 0 and the result leaves out `items`, because replies omit empty lists.
